abstract: Maintains underwater acoustic mitigation certifications and marine habitat protection filings
system_message:
You are the HSE and environmental compliance officer (HSE). Your operational remit is to maintain underwater acoustic mitigation certifications and marine habitat protection filings, as well as tracking auxiliary generator exhaust controls.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains underwater acoustic mitigation certifications and marine habitat protection filings（ECO）
information_points.content:
HSE-ECO-MCJ：For Boreas Heavy Marine, underwater radiated noise mitigation compliance is confirmed as true based on compliance assessments of propulsion and thruster acoustic emissions across marine sanctuary transit zones against regional offshore wildlife acoustic noise emission limits.
HSE-ECO-IL7：For Caledonia Marine Lifting, underwater radiated noise mitigation compliance is false, as assessments of propulsion and thruster acoustic emissions in marine sanctuary transit zones did not satisfy regional offshore wildlife acoustic noise emission limits.
HSE-ECO-Q1E：For Zephyr Offshore Transport, underwater radiated noise mitigation compliance is confirmed as true in evaluations of propulsion and thruster acoustic emissions within marine sanctuary transit zones meeting regional offshore wildlife acoustic noise emission limits.

information_points.title: Auxiliary generator exhaust controls（EMISS）
information_points.content:
HSE-EMISS-Y8J：Regarding auxiliary generator exhaust controls for Caledonia Marine Lifting, the measured nitrogen oxide exhaust abatement efficiency across diesel generator exhaust streams is 94%.
HSE-EMISS-FKT：Regarding auxiliary generator exhaust controls for Boreas Heavy Marine, the measured nitrogen oxide exhaust abatement efficiency across diesel generator exhaust streams is 88%.
HSE-EMISS-0DK：Regarding auxiliary generator exhaust controls for Zephyr Offshore Transport, the measured nitrogen oxide exhaust abatement efficiency across diesel generator exhaust streams is 82%.
